summary: Tested Check-in Page redesign for Fin & Feathers PWA. All UI elements present and functional. Mobile responsive layout works correctly. DJ role navigation works. Client and non-DJ staff roles redirect to /account due to SocialWallPage requiring user profile (expected behavior).

integration_issues.issue: When clicking Client or non-DJ staff roles, user is redirected to /account instead of /social/{location_slug}. This is because SocialWallPage.jsx (line 1020) requires ff_user_profile_id in localStorage. Users without a profile are redirected to /account to create one first.
integration_issues.priority: LOW - Expected behavior, users need profile to use social wall

issues: React hydration warning: span cannot be a child of option/select - cosmetic, doesn't affect functionality

critical_code_review_comments: CheckInPage.jsx is well-structured with proper data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Staff positions have unique colored icons as specified (DJ-red, Bartender-orange, Server-yellow, Cook-green, Manager-indigo)
Location auto-detection via geolocation works with fallback to first location
DJ role correctly navigates to /dj page
React hydration warning (span inside option/select) is a cosmetic issue from the Emergent visual editor wrapper

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all UI elements work, navigation works for DJ, other roles redirect to account as expected)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Check-in page redesign tested. All UI elements present: logo, location selector (8 locations), Client/Staff buttons, staff role picker (DJ, Bartender, Server, Cook, Manager), Back button, Home link, My Account link, Close button. Mobile responsive layout (390px) works correctly with side-by-side Client/Staff buttons. DJ role navigates to /dj correctly. Client and non-DJ staff roles redirect to /account because SocialWallPage requires user profile in localStorage (ff_user_profile_id). This is expected behavior - users need to create a profile first.
